description: This file defines a React functional component named EventDetailsModal that renders detailed information about an event within a modal dialog. It includes JSX markup to display event properties such as title, date/time, location, description, menu items, and attendees, along with a close button.

methods.name: EventDetailsModal
methods.description: React functional component rendering event details inside a modal. Receives props: open (boolean), onClose (function), and event (object with event details).
